Both of these compounds are known to modulate MAPK7 activity, indicating a potential role for benzocaine in influencing MAPK7 function through these intermediaries. The scores from the two paths suggest a moderate level of confidence in the relationship, with benzocaine being associated with MAPK7 through different molecular mechanisms.
